subject: gk
question: On 1 February 2021, _________ announced two schemes – Pragyan Bharati and Bhasha Gaurav – to provide monetary assistance to college students and literary bodies of the state.
solution:
Correct answer is__** Assam.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assam Chief Minister Sarbananda Sonowal** recently start two schemes known as** 'Pragyan Bharati' and 'Bhasha Gourab'.**
 
• Under Pragyan Bharati scheme**,** **funds are provided to college students for purchasing text books while under the Bhasha Gourab scheme,** the state government gives financial assistance to **21 Sahitya Sabhas (literary bodies).**
 
• **Pragyan Bharati Scooty Scheme** was started by the **Assam** Government, for those **candidates who scored at least 60 percent or above in their higher secondary school,** the selected candidates will get the free scooter from the government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Chhattisgarh government** has decided to launch the education scholarship under the name of **Chhattisgarh Mahtari Dulara Yojana**.
 
• Under the scheme, the Chhattisgarh government **stipend of rupees 500 per month will be paid to students from classes 1 to 8 and rupees 1000 per month for classes 9th to 12th. ​ **
 
• **West Bengal education scheme** _An unmarried girl child who is **13 to 18 years** old and reading in class **VIII/IX/XI/XII** will get annual scholarship of Rs. 750/- if annual income of her family is upto** Rs. 1.2 Lac.**
 
• School Education and Literacy Department, Govt. of Jharkhand initiated this ambitious programme for children studying in** Govt. Schools of Jharkhand.**
